newsitem.title: USA: Virginia delays Surry nuke restart until Sat.
newsitem.headline: Virginia delays Surry nuke restart until Sat.

text.p: Virginia Power Co said Wednesday it has delayed the restart of its 781 megawatt (MW) Surry 1 nuclear power unit until early Saturday.
"We had to repair some instrumentation. That repair has pushed back the restart to early Saturday," company spokesman Jim Norvelle said.
The unit, in Gravel Neck, Va., was earlier expected to return to the grid Wednesday morning after shutting down Friday due to a steam pipe leak.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at full power.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources Inc.
